rule: PASS iff (1) no sha256 equals any reference AND (2) max support IoU <= 0.50 AND (3) max cosine <= 0.90 AND (4) no sparse reference has containment > 0.98 with a lift > 3x over the random-emission null.  Continuous/lattice references are excluded from test (4) because their dilated support covers the map and the test would be vacuous.  Two artifacts anchored on the same mapped-fault network will ALWAYS show high mutual containment; that is a consequence of the metric's free-mass structure, not of copying, and tests (2) and (3) are what separate a re-emission from a copy.
